validation_scope: legacy-cell preservation and explicit semantics; NOT raw recomputation or causal validation

dictionary.scope: Five high-risk legacy aggregate tables; lossless semantic view, not full raw-data recertification
dictionary.source_preservation: Do not overwrite legacy CSVs, raw telemetry, logs or approved ZIPs

tilt.population: envs within one policy/case/evaluation seed; base-contact label is not posture fall
tilt.window: until first terminated/truncated, terminal row excluded
tilt.aggregation: per-env temporal mean, then equally weighted env means
tilt.limitations: q=1-gz^2 surrogate; equality to gx^2+gy^2 requires unverified unit norm. Terminal event counts and effective window sample counts may differ.
tilt.identity_status: UNKNOWN_FROM_AGGREGATE: resolve checkpoint/model/evaluator through original run manifests before cross-run comparison

robots.population: envs within one policy/case/evaluation seed; base-contact label is not posture fall
robots.window: until first terminated/truncated, terminal row excluded
robots.aggregation: per-env temporal mean, then equally weighted env means
robots.limitations: q=1-gz^2 surrogate; equality to gx^2+gy^2 requires unverified unit norm. Terminal event counts and effective window sample counts may differ.

terminated.formula: count distinct env with term_base_contact==1 before first done (including terminal row)
terminated.population: envs within one policy/case/evaluation seed; base-contact label is not posture fall
terminated.limitations: q=1-gz^2 surrogate; equality to gx^2+gy^2 requires unverified unit norm. Terminal event counts and effective window sample counts may differ.

tilt_survivors.population: envs with samples and no recorded base contact; NOT verified survivors
tilt_survivors.aggregation: per-env temporal mean, then equally weighted env means
tilt_survivors.limitations: q=1-gz^2 surrogate; equality to gx^2+gy^2 requires unverified unit norm. Terminal event counts and effective window sample counts may differ.

tilt_pre_term.population: base-contact envs having nonempty prewindow; effective count NOT STORED
tilt_pre_term.aggregation: unweighted mean of available per-env window means
tilt_pre_term.limitations: q=1-gz^2 surrogate; equality to gx^2+gy^2 requires unverified unit norm. Terminal event counts and effective window sample counts may differ.

pre_term_auc.population: available base-contact prewindow envs x non-base-contact episode envs
pre_term_auc.aggregation: all cross-group pairs; denominator NOT STORED; cannot assume robots-terminated if samples absent
pre_term_auc.limitations: q=1-gz^2 surrogate; equality to gx^2+gy^2 requires unverified unit norm. Terminal event counts and effective window sample counts may differ.

situations.population: evaluation seeds 101/202/303 pooled; climb group=10cm >=2 steps; stall group=15cm <1 step; upright label=non-base-contact, not posture verified
situations.window: climb: after settle/travel to peak; stall/upright: after settle to end; prefall: [end-1.0,end-0.5)
situations.aggregation: per-env selected-window mean then pooled-env mean; NOT equal-seed mean
situations.limitations: groups differ in terrain/window; seed identity lost in aggregation. These are selected observational groups, not a controlled causal contrast.
situations.identity_status: UNKNOWN_FROM_AGGREGATE: resolve checkpoint/model/evaluator through original run manifests before cross-run comparison
